decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - 1.	The proposed creation of 79 flats and a reduced size replacement community facility outside the town centre is considered to be an overdevelopment of this small corner site, resulting in inadequate accommodation for future occupiers, problems of parking and access, inadequate refuse and recycling facilities, and an excessive residential density, contrary to policies ENV-B 1.1, ENV-B 1.8, H 1.1, H 4.1, H 4.2, H 5.1, T 1.1, T 1.4 and T 4.3 of the Unitary Development Plan.  
2.	The proposed development would result in the loss of floorspace for community uses, contrary to policy C 1.3 of the Unitary Development Plan.
3.	The proposed 8 storey building, by way of its bulk, massing, proportion and location, is considered to be of an inappropriate scale and design, and would create an incongruous and dominating feature, out of character with the surrounding developments in the streetscene of London Road and Alderwick Drive, contrary to policies ENV-B 1.1 and ENV-B 1.2 of the Unitary Development Plan
4.	The proposed development will result in the loss of residential amenity to nearby residential properties, through loss of outlook, loss of light, loss of privacy, overshadowing and general increased noise and disturbance from the increased number of people and vehicles using the site, contrary to policies ENV-B 1.1, ENV-B 1.2, H 4.1, H 4.2 and T 1.4 of the Unitary Development Plan 
5.	The proposed increased in intensity of use of the site, with minimal provision for off street parking or servicing for both the flats and the community facility, and proposed excessive vehicular crossover, is likely to give rise to conditions prejudicial to the free flow of traffic on the public highway and increase in danger for traffic and pedestrians, contrary to policies ENV-B 1.1, T 1.4 and T 4.3 of the Unitary Development Plan
6.	The proposed development would result in the loss of mature trees on the site, which have amenity and landscape value, contrary to policy ENV-N 2.7 Unita
description: Erection of a 5, 7 & 8 storey block comprising new Senior Citizens Club, caretakers flat and 78 key worker affordable flats with associated access parking and landscaping.
